caption: The drawing shows a tall, two-part wooden cabinet rendered in shades of brown and accented with yellow hardware. The lower section contains three rows of drawers, each row consisting of two large drawers with ornate gold-colored handles; the lowest row is slightly wider, and the cabinet stands on four short, curved legs. The middle part includes a central alcove with an arched top flanked by columns, surrounded by small drawers and pigeonholes, all brown with matching yellow handles or knobs. The upper section features a pair of large doors (the right one shown open), each door with a curving decorative outline; the interior of the upper cabinet is divided into several compartments and cubbyholes with pointed arches. The top of the cabinet has a stepped cornice, further topped with two slanting triangular pediments. The lines and forms are outlined clearly and the entire composition appears set within a faint pencil rectangle on a cream-colored background. There is handwritten text at the bottom left indicating the scale and at the bottom right a signature.
title: Secretary
